summary: DC statehood advocates are highlighting recent challenges to the District's local authority while pointing to supportive statements from federal lawmakers. The ACLU has raised concerns about the National Guard's presence in D.C., and DC Vote has documented multiple attacks on local governance while tracking the current state of advocacy efforts. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
